sources.excerpt: He was Executive Vice President of Merchandising from June 2016 to January 2022, Senior Vice President, Real Estate Development, from August 2015 to June 2016, and Senior Vice President, General Manager, Northwest Region, from 2010 to July 2015.

sources.excerpt: Chief Executive Officer, President, and Director

sources.excerpt: Ron M. Vachris has been a director of the Company since February 2022, and Chief Executive Officer and President since January 2024. Mr. Vachris previously served as President and Chief Operating Officer from February 2022 to January 2024.

sources.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A), director nominee Ron M. Vachris
sources.excerpt: He spent the previous 28 years in various management positions in warehouse operations.

sources.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation Announces Craig Jelinek Will Step Down as CEO, Ron Vachris Elected as New CEO (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
sources.excerpt: The Board of Directors has elected Ron Vachris, President and Chief Operating Officer since February 2022, as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective January 1, 2024.

sources.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation Announces Craig Jelinek Will Step Down as CEO, Ron Vachris Elected as New CEO (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
sources.excerpt: Ron is a Costco veteran, with over forty years of service to the Company, starting as a forklift driver, and subsequently serving in every major role related to Costco's business operations and merchandising activities.

sources.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation Form 8-K (Item 5.02), February 3, 2022
sources.excerpt: Effective February 2, 2022, the Board of Directors appointed Ron Vachris as President and Chief Operating Officer of the Company.

sources.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation Form 8-K (Item 5.02), February 3, 2022
sources.excerpt: Mr. Vachris, age 56, previously served as Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, Merchandising, a position he held since 2016.

sources.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation Form 8-K (Item 5.02), February 3, 2022
sources.excerpt: Concurrently with his appointment as President and Chief Operating Officer of the Company, the Board of Directors elected Mr. Vachris as a director to fill a newly-created vacancy on the Board.

sources.title: Costco President and CEO Coming to SU (Seattle University News & Stories)
sources.excerpt: In 1982, Vachris started as a forklift driver at Price Club, which merged with Costco in 1993, and worked his way up through the company over the years becoming CEO in January 2024.

sources.title: Costco President and CEO Coming to SU (Seattle University News & Stories)
sources.excerpt: Along the way he held several management positions including warehouse manager in both Colorado and Arizona. He was promoted to Vice President of Operations in the San Diego Region in 1999, before moving to Washington state in 2010 and being promoted to Senior Vice President of the Northwest Region.

sources.title: Costco President and CEO Coming to SU (Seattle University News & Stories)
sources.excerpt: Shortly after, then-CEO Craig Jelinek asked Vachris to oversee buying for Costco and he became the Executive Vice President of merchandising in July 2016.

sources.title: Costco President and CEO Coming to SU (Seattle University News & Stories)
sources.excerpt: In August 2015, Jeff Brotman, who started Costco Wholesale with Jim Sinegal, asked Vachris to become the vice president of real estate development, giving him experience in working on international and domestic new markets and expansion.

sources.title: Costco CEO Ron Vachris rose from forklift driver to the C-suite without a college degree: ‘Don’t chase a title’ is the career advice that got him there (Fortune)
sources.excerpt: After graduating from high school in the early 1980s, he enrolled at Glendale Community College in Arizona, studying business while working part-time as a forklift driver for Price Club, the warehouse retailer that would merge with Costco in 1993. Before long, he was promoted to assistant warehouse manager—and never looked back on finishing a degree.

sources.title: Costco’s CEO started his career as a forklift driver. Now he’s leading a $254 billion giant rising up the Fortune 500 (Fortune)
sources.excerpt: Vachris began his career as a forklift driver in his teens for Price Club, which Costco merged with in 1993.

sources.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A), director nominee Hamilton E. James
sources.excerpt: Hamilton E. James has been a director of the Company since August 1988. He was the Lead Independent Director from 2005 until becoming the non-executive Chairman of the Board in August 2017.
